camel_example: aliyun cloudfw ModifyObjectGroupOperation --region cn-hangzhou --ObjectOperation ignore --ObjectType destinationDomain --ObjectList.1 '8.25.xxx.55' --Direction out
description_en: Modifies the operation for an object group
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-object-group-operation --object-operation ignore --object-type destinationDomain --direction out --object-list 8.25.xxx.55 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyObjectGroupOperation

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the visitor
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The operation to perform. Valid values:

subscribe: Follows the object.

unsubscribe: Unfollows the object.

ignore: Adds the object to the whitelist.

cancelIgnore: Removes the object from the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
操作加白、取消加白或关注、取消关注。
取值：

subscribe：关注。
unsubscribe：取消关注。
ignore：加白。
cancelIgnore：取消加白
parameters.name: object_operation

parameters.help_en:
The type of object to add to the whitelist or follow.

Valid values:

assetsIp: Asset IP address.

destinationIp: Destination IP address.

destinationPort: Destination port.

destinationDomain: Destination domain name
parameters.help_zh:
外联加白或关注类型。

取值：

assetsIp：资产ip。
destinationIp：目的ip。
destinationPort：目的端口。
destinationDomain：目的域名
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction that is controlled by the access control policy.

Valid values:

in: Inbound traffic.

out: Outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略管控的流量方向。

取值：

in：流量从外到内。
out：流量从内到外
parameters.name: direction
